sourcePriority: runtime files are implementation evidence, not rules authority

guards: Force Training creates 1+Wis modifier copies (minimum one) per feat; repeated feat grants repeat; extra per feat when Wisdom modifier increases.
Same Power definition may be selected more than once; copies are individually usable.
Replacements of chosen Force Powers require GM approval unless separately authorized.
committedEffects: Create distinct owned Force Power instances with unique document IDs and canonical definition provenance per copy.
Finalization must be idempotent by source session, selection and per-copy index.
regressionCases: Two copies of one Power are created without collapsing, have independent ready/spent state.
Reapplying same progression session does not create duplicate copies.
Acquiring same definition in a later legitimate training source creates another copy.
A normal non-GM 'change selection' is not treated as a free RAW respec.

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

guards: Starship Tactics provides 1+Wisdom modifier maneuvers, at least one, with each feat copy.
Maneuver definition may be selected more than once.
Wisdom modifier rise grants one extra maneuver per Starship Tactics feat.
committedEffects: Create distinct owned starship maneuver instances, with acquisition session and count index.
regressionCases: Repeated Corellian Slip creates two usable copies.
Legacy StarshipManeuverManager must not block a repeat authorized by RAW.
A Wisdom modifier rise credits every Starship Tactics feat exactly once.

guards: Exactly one eligible ready Power instance identified by owned Item ID.
Use the Force roll belongs to that activation; DC/tier/defense resolved by printed Power rule.
Attempt must consume Power whether baseline check succeeds or fails.
committedEffects: Mark only chosen copy expended; distinct copies remain ready.
Keep activation attempt and resulting effect instance separate for duration/maintenance.
regressionCases: Failed activation spends selected instance.
Second ready copy remains available after first spent.
A duplicate click against one spent instance fails without affecting the other.

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

guards: Pilot check specifically to activate maneuver (except individual maneuver override; Force maneuver still follows stated published activation).
A failed baseline check wastes action and spends copy.
committedEffects: Mark only selected maneuver instance spent; activate effects only when legal.
Attack patterns tracked separately from spent/ready state.
regressionCases: Failed Pilot activation consumes selected copy.
Successful activation applies correct tier and source-specific effects.
Duplicate maneuver copy remains ready.

guards: Official October 2008 errata replaces broad printed UTF roll wording with natural20 on an actual Use the Force check to activate a Force Power.
Recovery occurs at END OF ACTOR TURN; no Force Point awarded by this rule.
Do not treat take-10 or unrelated UTF skill check as triggering recovery.
committedEffects: Queue one end-turn recover-all of existing spent Force Power instances, including Power used in triggering activation.
No FP mutation. Receipt identifies roll and turn.
regressionCases: Power activation raw d20 20 recovers all only at actor end turn.
Unrelated UTF skill use raw d20 20 does not recover.
Natural 20 never grants 1 FP without a separate printed feat/feature.
The activating instance is included in end-turn recovery.

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

guards: Natural20 on Pilot check ACTUALLY used to activate a starship maneuver.
Does not apply to other Pilot checks, gunner attack rolls or Target Sense UTF.
committedEffects: Queue end-turn recover-all of spent maneuver instances; no immediate recovery.
regressionCases: Pilot activation nat20 recovers at end of turn only.
Other Pilot nat20 does not recover maneuvers.
One target-sense UTF nat20 does not recover maneuvers.

guards: Explicit reaction under official p93 errata and Core p96.
Exactly one spent owned Power instance selected before FP debit; applicable restrictions and one-FP-per-round rules evaluated.
A specific source ability may authorize exceptions; generic Force Readiness is not prerequisite for this printed reaction.
committedEffects: Atomically debit exactly one eligible FP and ready exactly one selected spent Power instance.
No refundless FP spend if invalid target or mutation fails.
regressionCases: Invalid/already ready/missing target costs zero FP.
One spent copy returns ready; other same-name copy unchanged.
Actor with no Force Readiness can use explicit printed reaction.
Concurrent duplicate requests cannot debit twice or recover more than paid.

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

guards: Reaction explicitly allowed by Starships p24, even if not a generic off-turn allowance.
Exactly one eligible spent maneuver instance selected in advance.
Normal FP limit and source-specific exception checks apply.
committedEffects: Debit exactly 1 FP and immediately ready one maneuver instance via ActorEngine.
regressionCases: Single spent instance recovery changes exactly one copy.
No Force Readiness prereq invented for this printed reaction.
No spent item gives no debit; double submission cannot recover twice.

guards: Actual combat over and meaningful opportunity to rest for 1 minute; deleting Combat document is not proof.
Only owned spent Power instances recover, not temporary non-recoverable powers.
committedEffects: Recover all eligible spent Power copies after validated rest receipt.
Do not terminate a separately active duration effect solely because the suite copy became ready.
regressionCases: deleteCombat alone recovers zero.
Rest completion recovers spent copies in all aliases only after single canonical-state cutover.
Non-recoverable temporary Power remains excluded.

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

guards: Starship battle ended AND one-minute rest opportunity occurred.
A GM/admin reset may exist but must be distinctly marked and never mislabelled RAW rest.
committedEffects: Recover all spent maneuver instances after evidence of full rest.
regressionCases: deleteCombat alone recovers zero.
Starship encounter then full rest recovers all copies.
Crew-linked owned instances correctly recover on actual owning actor.

guards: Actor and reason identified; sufficient resource available.
Default no more than one FP per round unless printed specific permission says otherwise.
Action timing source-specific (roll-mod free on own turn, Power/Maneuver recovery reactions, special activation costs as printed).
Power [dark side] and [light side] constraints on FP-modified Use the Force checks are enforced before spending.
committedEffects: Single authorized resource debit receipt carrying source, round, action, amount, relevant exception, paid type and before/after.
Bonus FP source restrictions evaluated; actor mutation via ActorEngine only.
regressionCases: Ordinary second FP same round denied absent specific exception.
SotG/Core reaction recovery allowed even without Force Readiness.
An invalid spend cannot mutate bonus or normal FP pool.
Concurrent spends and rollback preserve exact resource accounting.

guards: [dark side] Power UTF activation check cannot be modified with an FP and using one increases Dark Side Score by one (subject to separately valid published exception).
[light side] Power UTF check cannot use FP modification when actor Dark Side Score >=1.
No assumption that all Force Point Power-specific benefits are forbidden; restriction is on modifying that Use the Force check.
committedEffects: Reject illegal bonus transaction before rolling; settle dark-side consequences on actual use with traceable event receipt.
regressionCases: Dark-side power cannot spend FP to boost UTF and increments DSS upon use.
Actor with DSS 1+ cannot FP-boost a light-side Power UTF check.
Legal unrelated source-specific Force Point option still available when rules permit.
No double DSP between activateForce() and executeForcePower().

source.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide.pdf

guards: Maintained effect instance exists and has not expired.

Action paid EACH round for EACH maintained instance: Energy Resistance swift; Kinetic Combat swift (plus stated standard action to direct weapon); Resist Force swift; Valor swift; Force Whirlwind move and new UTF check.
Core errata: Force Grip and Move Object maintenance costs standard action plus new UTF check.
On damage taken while maintaining one of these, UTF DC 15+damage taken.
Special break clauses: Force Whirlwind ends if caster/ally damages, attacks or moves target down condition track; Move Object cannot be maintained after dealing damage.
committedEffects: Store effect-instance identity distinct from learned copy; pay per-instance actions; register any on-damage check and clear only invalidated effect.
regressionCases: Two Resist Force effects require two distinct swift actions.
Whirlwind maintenance move action rerolls UTF every round.
Whirlwind ends when printed prohibited interference occurs.
Core Grip and Move Object need separate standard+UTF checks.
Check DC equals 15+actual damage, and failure ends that effect only.

guards: Expiry determined by per-effect start and source duration, not power card ready/spent bit.
Individual maintenance failures, printed break triggers and encounter end can end effects.
Recovery of a Power instance does not itself cancel unrelated ongoing duration unless explicit rule says so.
committedEffects: Delete exactly affected effect instance, not every effect sharing Power name.
Tie persistent effect to owning actor, activation receipt and source item ID.
regressionCases: Recovering one spent Power leaves valid maintained effects intact.
Ending one of two Valor instances leaves other active.
Rest recovery does not silently erase unrelated active effects.

guards: Normal Force Power selections cannot be changed without GM approval (Core p95).
Authorized removal references explicit owned copy; a definition name alone is insufficient where copies differ.
committedEffects: Delete only authorized owned Item ID(s); preserve other same-definition copies and their original provenance.
regressionCases: Respec without GM/source entitlement rejected.
Removing second of three copies cannot delete first or third.
Persistence/source provenance remains stable for untouched copies.

guards: Do not invent free respec; require GM or a printed separate entitlement.
Removal targets one explicitly owned instance, not an abstract definition.
committedEffects: Remove only selected item ID; leave other maneuver copies intact.
regressionCases: Removing one duplicate leaves other ready/spent copy independent.
A generic same-name remove never randomly picks an item.
No phantom free swap from RAW-trained maneuver suite.

guards: GM explicitly enables printed option; not silently mapped to strict/lenient/narrative setting.
Power option: FP adds one temporary [dark side] Force Power with special first-use/end-encounter expiration, not normally recoverable.
Talent option: separate temporary prerequisite-qualified Dark Side/Devotee/Sith talents, may prerequisite-chain; cleanup and final dark-side tally source-specific.
committedEffects: Temporary entitlements have separate reversible records, acquisition/expiry receipts, FP and DSP ledgers.
Do not forge permanent learned Force Power copies.
regressionCases: GM opt-in false blocks both temporary routes.
Temp Power never recovered through generic power suite recovery.
Valid chained temporary talents expire at encounter end with correct DSS accounting.
No permanent Power Item persists after expiration.

Power deleteCombat hook grants no-rest recovery and uses system.spent while executor writes system.discarded
Maneuver deleteCombat hook restores spent copies before required one-minute rest
Recover-all UI invokes generic ForceExecutor.recoverForcePowers(actor) without rest/trigger receipt
Recover-one spends FP before validating chosen spent Power ID; invalid request can cost FP
ActorEngine.spendForcePoints lacks visible per-round one-FP accounting and reason/timing validation while used by direct consumers
Rolled ForceExecutor.executeForcePower path does not explicitly gate FP modification by [dark side] or [light side] descriptors and DSS; DSP update only apparent in alternate activateForce path
Force recovery removes origin-linked active effects; restoration of readiness should not itself terminate a valid maintained effect

guardrails: RAW/official errata are authoritative, not original printed mistakes.
No invented Force Point reward on natural20.
Core errata restricts natural20 recovery to Use the Force activation of a Force Power; unrelated skill checks excluded.
Power versus maneuver natural20 triggers use different skills, each activation-specific.
Suite copies are independent, and maintained effects are separate from suite readiness.
No free automatic recovery on deleteCombat; require rest opportunity or other legal event.
An explicit recovery reaction is a RAW-specific off-turn permission; generic feat not required.
Do not add compatibility shims or fake compendium Items.
Only ActorEngine mutates actor resource/item state; other services validate and orchestrate.
